answer.text: Regular VaR + Cost of unwinding position

explanation.text: The Logic: LA-VaR = VaR + unwind cost (bid-ask × position). Accounts for the fact that losing a big position includes the cost to actually exit. The Trap: Ignoring unwind cost underestimates true stress loss — a key learning post-2008. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific. Manager's Pro-Tip: For illiquid small-cap PMS books, the unwind cost can exceed the statistical VaR — explicitly model it in stress scenarios.
